meta.title: CaloSnap: AI calorie counter from a photo
meta.description: Snap your meal and CaloSnap's AI counts calories, protein, carbs and fat in seconds. Food diary, barcode scanner, AI Chef and AI Nutritionist in one simple app.

hero.title: Snap it.
hero.subtitle: Take a photo of your meal and CaloSnap's AI recognises the food, estimates the portion and counts calories and macros in seconds. No manual searching, no guesswork.
hero.note: Free to download. Available in 9 languages.

features.title: Everything you need to eat smarter
features.subtitle: One app for logging food, tracking progress and reaching your goal, without the tedious parts.

scan.title: AI photo scanner
scan.text: Recognises dishes, several foods on one plate and portion sizes, then counts calories, protein, carbs and fat.

barcode.title: Barcodes and labels
barcode.text: Scan a product barcode or photograph the nutrition label, and the values are filled in for you.

diary.title: Diary, water and weight
diary.text: See every meal of the day, track water with one tap and follow your weight on a clear chart.

goal.title: Personal calorie goal
goal.text: Your daily target and macros are calculated from your age, height, weight, activity and goal.

feast.title: Feast mode
feast.text: Had a wedding or a holiday dinner? Spread the extra calories gently over the next few days and keep your streak.

secure.title: Private and secure
secure.text: Lock the app with Face ID or fingerprint. No ads, and your data is never sold.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Logging a meal takes about five seconds.

snap.title: Snap
snap.text: Take a photo of your plate, scan a barcode or pick a photo from your gallery.

analyze.title: AI analyses
analyze.text: The AI identifies each food, estimates the weight and calculates its nutrition.

log.title: Add to diary
log.text: Adjust the portion if needed and save. Your daily progress updates instantly.

ai.title: A nutritionist and a chef in your pocket
ai.subtitle: Beyond counting calories, CaloSnap helps you decide what to eat next.

chef.title: AI Chef
chef.text: Photograph your fridge or list your ingredients, and get 3 healthy recipes that fit your goal, with calories per serving.

nutritionist.title: AI Nutritionist
nutritionist.text: Ask anything about your diet and get answers based on your goal, daily target and today's meals.

health.title: Health alerts
health.text: If you have diabetes, high blood pressure or high cholesterol, meals are checked and you get a gentle warning when something doesn't suit you.

ai.disclaimer: CaloSnap gives general guidance and is not medical advice. Always follow your doctor's instructions.

pro.title: Unlock the full power of AI
pro.subtitle: The core features are free. Pro removes the limits and adds the AI assistants.

items.scan: Unlimited AI scanning and international barcodes
items.multi: Several dishes or a whole table in one photo
items.chef: AI Chef: healthy recipes from what's in your fridge
items.health: Meal alerts for diabetes, blood pressure and cholesterol

pro.note: Weekly, monthly and yearly plans. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Cancel anytime in your App Store or Google Play settings.

accuracy.q: How accurate is the calorie estimate?
accuracy.a: For most everyday meals the AI is close to real values, but it's still an estimate. You can always correct the food or the portion weight before saving.

foods.a: Home-cooked dishes, national cuisine, fast food, drinks and packaged products. For packaged foods a barcode or label scan is the most precise.

privacy.a: Your data is used only to run the app. We don't show ads or sell data, and you can delete your account and all data from your profile at any time.

free.a: Yes. The diary, goals, water and weight tracking and daily AI scans are free. CaloSnap Pro adds unlimited scanning and the AI assistants.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Subscriptions are managed by the App Store or Google Play. Open your account's subscription settings on your phone and cancel there.

languages.a: Uzbek, Russian, English, Turkish, Kazakh, Korean, Spanish, German and French.

cta.title: Start eating smarter today
cta.subtitle: Download CaloSnap and log your first meal in seconds.

footer.tagline: AI calorie counter from a photo.
